concept_name:
Diagnostic revealed a broken 3 wye in the kitchen under the foundation.
There is also another broken 4 wye at the exterior beam for the 3 compartment sink drain.
Plan of action is to apply for a permit with the customers jurisdiction to legally and professional proceed with repairs. - Begin by prepping the interior of the kitchen with either plastic or cardboard to help protect from construction dust. Then we will utilize specialized equipment to create a direct access entry hole located at the doorway into the kitchen . Then we will tunnel remove the soil to expose the broken 3wye.

If additional tunneling or beam penetration is needed a supplemented estimated will be provided. - If any more work is needed such as solid rock removal roots or any unforeseeable objects come across this estimate will be supplemented to accommodate the time/material needed to complete the job. - Defective drains will be removed from plumbing system and debris will be hauled away. - Drains will then be replaced with new DWV schedule 40 PVC pipe and fittings in accordance to plumbing code.

Then we will dig down at the exterior to expose the 4 wye and perform repairs.
